flags.title: Feature Flags
flags.description: Create, manage, and control feature rollouts for your application
flags.edit_description: Update flag configuration and targeting rules.
flags.create_description: Add a new feature flag to control feature rollouts.
flags.key_hint: Lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens. Cannot be changed after creation.
flags.key_min: Flag key must be at least 2 characters
flags.key_max: Flag key must be at most 64 characters
flags.key_format: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (for example, new-reader-v2).
flags.rollout_hint: Percentage of users who see this feature (0-100)
flags.rules_hint: Optional: restrict this flag to specific user segments
flags.tiers_hint: Leave unchecked to allow all tiers
flags.user_ids_hint: Comma-separated list of user IDs. Leave empty for all users.
flags.lifecycle_hint: Set an expiry date to prevent stale flags
flags.set_expiry_hint: Choose when this feature flag should expire.
flags.invalid_array: Expected a JSON array of flag objects
flags.delete_description: Are you sure you want to delete the flag "{key}"? This action cannot be undone and may affect live users.
flags.description_size: Description must be 500 characters or less.
flags.owner_size: Owner must be 100 characters or less.
flags.rollout_range: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
